battle.name: 狼尾灘之戰
battle.brief: 開皇八年（588）十二月，隋行軍元帥楊素率舟師出永安，順流穿三峽，至流頭灘為陳將戚昕所守狼尾灘阻擋。楊素乘夜掩之，率黃龍艦數千艘銜枚而下，遣開府王長襲以步卒自南岸攻其別柵，劉仁恩率甲騎自白沙北岸遲明而至，天明合擊，戚昕敗走，三峽門戶洞開。卡面羅馬短劍同屬近身刺擊之器，在本役只佔兵器序列末段。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 開皇八年（588）十月，隋文帝楊堅在壽春設淮南行省，以晉王楊廣為尚書令總攬伐陳全局，命晉王楊廣、秦王楊俊、清河公楊素並為行軍元帥，高熲為元帥長史，合總管九十、兵五十一萬八千，皆受晉王節度。狼尾灘之戰出自楊素所領的中上游一路：楊素以司空行軍元帥的身份駐永安（白帝城），督造五牙、黃龍等大艦，率舟師出長江三峽；荊州刺史劉仁恩率兵自江陵溯江西上，所部甲騎與步卒參與本役；開府王長襲受命引步卒自南岸趨擊敵營。南朝陳一方則以江防為主，都督巴峽緣江諸軍事的周羅睺與郢州刺史荀法尚率數萬眾據江夏拒隋，荊州刺史陳慧紀自公安率將士三萬、樓船千餘乘欲東下建康，南康內史呂忠肅死守歧亭並以三條鐵鎖橫江封住西陵峽口；狼尾灘的守將是戚昕，只擔一隅而無大軍策應，陳後主陳叔寶居建康總裁全局。
countriesEn: In the tenth month of 588, the tenth year of the Kaihuang era, Emperor Wen of Sui Yang Jian set up the Huainan administrative province at Shouchun and put Prince Jin Yang Guang in overall command of the campaign against Chen, appointing Yang Guang, Prince of Qin Yang Jun and the Duke of Qinghe Yang Su as co-commanders of the expeditionary armies, with Gao Jiong as chief of staff. Altogether ninety commanders and 518,000 soldiers took the field, all of them under the orders of Prince Jin. The battle of Langweitan was fought by the middle and upper course of the river assigned to Yang Su: as司空 and commander-in-chief of the expedition he was stationed at Yong'an, present-day Fengjie in Sichuan, where he had the great warships Wuya and Huanglong built, and he led his flotilla out through the Three Gorges of the Yangtze. The governor of Jingzhou Liu Renen marched up the river from Jiangling, bringing armoured cavalry and foot soldiers into the action, and the imperial commissioner Wang Changxi was ordered to lead infantry from the southern bank against the enemy camp. On the Chen side everything rested on the river defence: Zhou Luohou, commander of the military affairs of Baxian and the river shores, and Xun Fashang, governor of Yongzhou, held Jiangxia with several tens of thousands of men to bar the Sui advance; the governor of Jingzhou Chen Huiji was moving down from Gong'an with thirty thousand troops and more than a thousand tower ships towards Jiankang; and Lü Zhongsu, internal administrator of Nankang, held Qiting and threw three iron chains across the river to seal the western mouth of the Xiling Gorge. The garrison at Langweitan was commanded by Qi Xin, who was responsible for a single sector with no field army at hand, while the Chen emperor Chen Shubao remained at Jiankang to direct everything from the centre.
people: 楊素是本役的決定者。隋書卷四十八記他出師前的一段話：勝負大計在此一舉，若晝日下船，彼則見我，灘流迅激，制不由人，則吾失其便。於是他以夜掩之，親率黃龍數千艘銜枚而下，即乘員口含木片不作聲息，順流疾馳。開府王長襲受命引步卒從南岸擊戚昕別柵，大將軍劉仁恩率甲騎趣白沙北岸，遲明而至，天明時與舟師會合攻擊，戚昕敗走。戚昕是陳朝上游的名將，早年為梁朝將領時曾襲擊公安，到隋伐陳時已鎮守巴峽最上一段要衝，本役他據灘築柵固守，卻沒有料到對方敢在急流之下夜航強攻。隋方另一關鍵人物是元帥長史高熲，他獻策請隋文帝微徵士馬、聲言掩襲，藉以擾亂陳國農時、焚燒其儲積，使陳廷在戰前數年便已疲敝。陳後主陳叔寶與掌機密的施文慶、沈客卿則是失敗的關鍵：上游失守的消息被壓在朝廷裡，隋軍東下的情報始終沒有送到建康。
peopleEn: Yang Su was the man who decided the battle. The History of Sui, volume forty-eight, preserves his words before the operation: the whole issue of victory and defeat turns on this one move; if we put the men ashore in daylight they will see us coming, and the race of the shoal is so swift that the ships can no longer be controlled, and then we lose our advantage. He therefore covered the attack with darkness, himself leading several thousand Huanglong ships with the crews holding a wooden gag so that not a sound was made, driving downstream with the current. The imperial commissioner Wang Changxi was ordered to bring infantry from the southern bank against Qi Xin's separate camp, while the general Liu Renen took armoured cavalry to the north bank at Baisha and arrived at first light, so that when day broke the land and river forces struck together and Qi Xin broke and ran. Qi Xin was a noted commander of the upper river for the Chen dynasty; having served the Liang court as a general he had earlier raided Gong'an, and by the time the Sui invaded he was holding the uppermost reach of the Baxian line. In this battle he fortified his position at the shoal with a stockade, but he had not expected the enemy to risk a night passage through the racing current. The other decisive Sui figure was Gao Jiong, chief of staff, whose stratagem was to call up troops and soldiers on the pretext of an imminent raid, so that the Chen court would mass its garrison, neglect the farming season and lose its stores to fire; the enemy was exhausted years before the war began. The losing side was shaped by the Chen emperor Chen Shubao together with the keepers of the secretariat, Shi Wenqing and Shen Keqing: the news of the reverse on the upper river was suppressed inside the court, and the intelligence that the Sui were moving east never reached Jiankang.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬短劍是刺擊型的近身兵器，不靠揮砍取勝，靠盾的邊緣與刺突的節奏取勝；放進本役的裝備序列裡，它對應的是攻柵登岸之後的最後一段搏鬥，而不是舟師本身。隋軍舟師主力是五牙大艦與黃龍艦：五牙樓五層、高百餘尺，左右前後置六拍竿並高五十尺，可容戰士八百人，黃龍置兵百人，另有平乘、舴艋等小艇隨行；登岸的步卒靠戟、矛、環首刀與鎲甲，劉仁恩所部則是甲騎。陳軍方面，狼尾灘守軍以柵壘、弓弩與長槍拒守，戚昕的別柵是本役攻防的核心；上游還有陳朝以鐵鎖橫江的舊法，呂忠肅在歧亭用三條鐵鎖封住峽口。陳朝水軍另有樓船千餘乘與拍車、偏箱車這類車兵裝備同在江防序列之內。羅馬短劍這類短刺劍與中國的環首刀、匕首同屬窄地搏鬥的兵器：船艦甲板、灘頭泥地與柵壘缺口都沒有揮砍的空間，能穩定刺穿的只有瞄準與節奏。
kitsEn: The Roman short sword on the card face is a thrusting weapon for close quarters; it does not win by cutting, it wins through the edge of the shield and the rhythm of the thrust. Placed inside the equipment sequence of this battle, it corresponds to the last stage of the fight after the stockade has been stormed, not to the flotilla itself. The backbone of the Sui fleet was the great tower ship Wuya and the Huanglong: Wuya carried five decks rising more than a hundred feet, with six swinging beams on her fore, aft and both sides, each fifty feet high, and room for eight hundred fighting men, while the Huanglong housed a hundred soldiers; smaller craft such as the flat-bottomed pingcheng and the zhameng followed in company. The landing foot soldiers carried halberds, spears, ring-pommel sabres and lamellar armour, and Liu Renen's troops were armoured cavalry. On the Chen side the garrison at Langweitan met the attack from behind a stockade, with bows, crossbows and long spears, and the separate camp of Qi Xin was the hinge of the whole engagement. Upstream the Chen still used the old method of chaining the river shut, and at Qiting Lü Zhongsu sealed the mouth of the gorge with three iron chains. The Chen navy also had more than a thousand tower ships and such carriage-borne engines as the beating cart and the side-box cart within the same river defence order of battle. A short thrusting sword such as the Roman gladius stands in the same family as the Chinese ring-pommel sabre and the dagger: weapons of confined fighting. On a ship's deck, on wet mud at a shoal, in the gap of a breached stockade there is no room to swing, and the only things that can be driven home reliably are aim and rhythm.
tactics: 本役的戰術核心只有一句話：夜掩。狼尾灘緊扼三峽西口，江流在灘前急湍，隋舟師若在白晝下船或放慢速度，陳軍居高遠望即可先發制人；楊素因此判斷必須趁黑順流疾下。作戰分成三路：其一，他親率黃龍艦數千艘銜枚而行，乘夜色順流直下，抵近灘口；其二，開府王長襲率步卒提前由南岸登岸，直取戚昕的別柵，迫使守軍分兵抵禦；其三，劉仁恩率甲騎取道白沙北岸，在天明時趕到，形成南北夾擊。守軍的優勢——長槍的刺殺力、弓弩的射程與柵壘的遮蔽——都因夜色而失效；待天光乍現，隋軍已在灘上登岸，陳軍視線受阻而隋軍已據灘頭。整個作戰沒有正面強攻，也沒有長期圍城，靠的是舟師順流的時間差、騎兵在平地上的速度，以及夜戰對士氣的放大。奪灘之後，楊素水軍得以繼續東下，把三峽這道天險變成通道。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of this battle can be reduced to a single phrase: cover the attack with darkness. Langweitan gripped the western mouth of the Three Gorges, and the current ran so hard in front of the shoal that if the Sui flotilla had put its men ashore or slowed down in daylight the Chen garrison, looking down from the heights, could have struck first. Yang Su therefore judged that the only way was to drive down with the current under cover of night. The operation was split into three parts. First, he himself led several thousand Huanglong ships with the crews gagged, running downstream in the dark to close on the shoal. Second, the imperial commissioner Wang Changxi took infantry ashore in advance from the southern bank and struck straight at Qi Xin's separate camp, forcing the defenders to divide. Third, Liu Renen led armoured cavalry by way of the north bank at Baisha and arrived as day broke, closing the jaws from north and south. The advantages of the defenders, the reach of the spear, the range of the bow and the cover of the stockade, were all cancelled by the darkness; when the light came the Sui were already ashore on the shoal, the Chen could not see while the Sui held the high ground. There was no frontal assault on a prepared position and no long siege: the battle rested on the time saved by the current, on the speed of cavalry across open ground, and on what night fighting did to the morale of the men. Once the shoal was taken, Yang Su's fleet was able to continue downstream and turned the Three Gorges from a barrier into a corridor.
data: 有據可查的數字如下。隋軍全役出動總管九十、兵五十一萬八千，由晉王楊廣節度；其中楊素一路的水軍，隋書卷四十八記他親率黃龍數千艘銜枚而下，後世史家亦記作率艦船數千艘東下。楊素在永安所造五牙大艦，樓五層、高百餘尺、置六拍竿並高五十尺、容戰士八百人，次曰黃龍置兵百人。同期楊俊率水陸軍十萬出襄陽進屯漢口，行軍總管周法尚率舟師三萬攻樊口；陳軍方面，周羅睺與荀法尚率數萬眾據江夏，荊州刺史陳慧紀自公安率將士三萬、樓船千餘乘東下。時間線也清楚：588年10月大軍出師，588年12月楊俊屯漢口、楊素取狼尾灘，589年正月隋軍渡江，589年1月20日建康陷落。交戰本身沒有留下確切的斬首與俘虜數，史料只記欣敗走一語，故不另擬數字。地理上，狼尾灘在今湖北宜昌西北，緊貼三峽西口，距離流頭灘（今宜昌西）不遠，自永安出發須連日穿峽，江道數百里。
dataEn: The figures that can be documented run as follows. For the campaign as a whole the Sui mustered ninety commanders and 518,000 soldiers, all under the orders of Prince Jin Yang Guang. Of that force the contingent of Yang Su was a river force: the History of Sui, volume forty-eight, records that he led several thousand Huanglong ships himself, gagged and silent, driving down the river, and later historians write of some thousands of warships being sent downstream. The great ship Wuya built by Yang Su at Yong'an had five decks more than a hundred feet high, six swinging beams each fifty feet tall on her fore, aft and both sides, and space for eight hundred fighting men, while the Huanglong carried a hundred soldiers. At the same time Yang Jun marched out of Xiangyang with a hundred thousand soldiers and both arms and took up position at Hankou, while the expeditionary commander Zhou Fashang took a flotilla of thirty thousand to attack Fankou. On the Chen side Zhou Luohou and Xun Fashang held Jiangxia with several tens of thousands of men, and the governor of Jingzhou Chen Huiji moved down from Gong'an with thirty thousand soldiers and more than a thousand tower ships. The chronology is equally clear: the armies marched out in the tenth month of 588; in the twelfth month of 588 Yang Jun was at Hankou and Yang Su had taken Langweitan; in the first month of 589 the Sui crossed the Yangtze; on 20 January 589 Jiankang fell. The engagement itself left behind no exact count of enemy dead or prisoners, the historical record saying only that Qi Xin broke and ran, so no further numbers are invented here. Geographically Langweitan lies north-west of Yichang in modern Hubei, hard against the western mouth of the Three Gorges and not far from Liutou shoal to the west of Yichang; from Yong'an the fleet had to run the gorges for days on end along several hundred li of river.
cause: 隋朝打陳不是一天決定的。隋文帝在北方收拾北周、壓平尉遲迥等反抗、平定突厥之後，才把目光轉向江南；經濟上靠均田與租庸調充實府庫，軍事上以府兵制集中兵權，令賀若弼、韓擒虎分任吳州、廬州總管專練水軍，令楊素在永安造大艦。元帥長史高熲獻策，主張微徵士馬、聲言掩襲，逼陳廷屯兵禦守而廢其農時，再密遣行人因風縱火焚其儲積，反覆數年，使陳國財力俱盡。開戰之前，隋廷扣留陳朝來聘的使臣以保守機密，斷絕往來。陳朝這邊的破綻同樣清楚：陳後主自恃王氣在此，說齊兵三度來、周兵再度至都無不摧敗；都官尚書孔範更稱長江天塹不可飛渡，隋軍只須自敗；掌機密的施文慶與沈客卿把上游軍情扣下不報，朝廷甚至在元會將至時把江州、南徐州戰船召回建康歡慶， 江防為之更弱。於是隋軍選中最上游的門戶下手——自永安出發，三峽西口的狼尾灘成了必經的瓶頸。
causeEn: The Sui decision to attack Chen was not taken in a day. Only after settling the northern inheritance of the Zhou, crushing the revolts of Wei Tujiong and his rivals and dealing with the Turks did Emperor Wen turn his eyes to the south; on the economic side he filled the treasuries through the equal-field system and the levies of grain, cloth and labour, on the military side he concentrated command in the fubing system, set He Ruobi and Han Qinhu as governors of Wu and Lu respectively to train the river forces, and had Yang Su build his great ships at Yong'an. Gao Jiong, chief of staff, offered the stratagem that lay behind the campaign: call up troops and soldiers on the pretext of an imminent raid so that the Chen court must mass its garrison and let the farming season go to waste, and then send men by night with the wind to set fire to the stores; repeated over several years, this drained the wealth of the Chen state. Before the war began the Sui court detained Chen envoys in order to keep the operation secret and cut off intercourse. The flaws on the Chen side were just as clear. The emperor Chen Shubao relied on the saying that the imperial vapour lay here, and boasted that the armies of Qi had come three times and those of Zhou twice without ever failing; the minister of works Kong Fan went further, declaring that the great moat of the Yangtze could not be flown over and that the northern army would destroy itself. Shi Wenqing and Shen Keqing, who held the secretariat, pressed down the news from the upper river instead of reporting it, and the court even recalled the warships of Jiangzhou and southern Xuzhou to Jiankang to celebrate the new year, thinning the river defence still further. The Sui therefore struck at the uppermost gate: setting out from Yong'an, the shoal of Langweitan at the western mouth of the Three Gorges was the neck through which every army had to pass.
impact: 狼尾灘的陷落直接改變了長江中游的整體局勢。陳朝原以三峽與巴峽為天然屏蔽，隋軍舟師一旦能順流東下，江陵、武昌之間再無險可守；陳慧紀自公安帶來的三萬人與樓船千餘乘被楊俊軍阻於漢口，不能北上救援建康；隋軍隨即會師漢口，長江中游盡入隋手，陳朝只剩下建康、三吳與嶺南。到589年1月20日建康陷落，陳後主被韓擒虎俘獲，陳亡，隋朝旋即招降三吳與嶺南，嶺南冼夫人驗過扶南犀杖與兵符之後派孫子迎接隋使，悉地歸附。從長遠看，狼尾灘這一仗的意義不止於一場遭遇戰：它把長江天塹從分裂的象徵改造成統一王朝內部的航道，隋文帝其後興建大運河，自涿郡通到餘杭，把政治中心與江南財賦綁在一條水路上，結束了魏晉南北朝近四百年的分裂，為唐代的繁盛鋪平了道路。
impactEn: The loss of Langweitan changed the whole situation in the middle Yangtze at a stroke. The Chen had counted on the Three Gorges and the Baxian gorges as their natural screen; once the Sui fleet could run down the river, nothing stood between Jiangling and Wuchang. The thirty thousand men and more than a thousand tower ships that Chen Huiji brought down from Gong'an were held at Hankou by Yang Jun's army and could not march north to relieve Jiankang; the Sui forces soon joined hands at Hankou, the whole middle river fell to the Sui, and the Chen were left with Jiankang, the Three Wu regions and Lingnan. When Jiankang fell on 20 January 589 and Han Qinhu took the Chen emperor prisoner, the Chen dynasty ended, and the Sui moved at once to accept the submission of the Three Wu and of Lingnan, where the matriarch Xian, after checking the Funan rhinoceros staff and the tiger tally, sent her grandson to welcome the Sui envoy and the whole region submitted. In the longer term the meaning of the fight at Langweitan went far beyond a single engagement: it turned the Yangtze barrier from the symbol of a divided land into a waterway inside a unified empire. The canal that Emperor Wen later ordered, running from Zhuojun to Yuhang, tied the political centre to the wealth of the south in a single line of transport, ended the nearly four centuries of division that had run from the Wei, Jin and the Northern and Southern Dynasties, and paved the way for the prosperity of the Tang.
result: 結果是隋軍奪取狼尾灘，陳將戚昕敗走，別柵被攻破，狼尾灘守軍被逐出灘頭，陳朝在上游的門戶洞開。楊素的水軍得以沿長江繼續東下，與劉仁恩軍會合後再攻歧亭，至589年正月攻破呂忠肅以鐵鎖橫江之陣，盡取西陵峽口；同年楊素與楊俊會師漢口，長江中游全線歸隋。此役之後，陳朝已無力再組織上游防禦：周羅睺、陳慧紀等被牽制於漢口一帶，荊州、湘州相繼失守，隋軍主力得以放手南攻建康。狼尾灘之戰本身的斬獲數字史無明文，只留下戚昕敗走與隋軍夜渡急流的記載，但它在整個伐陳戰役中的位置十分清楚——是打開長江上游的鑰匙。
resultEn: The outcome was that the Sui seized Langweitan, the Chen general Qi Xin broke and ran, his separate camp was carried by assault, the garrison was driven off the shoal, and the gate on the upper river stood wide open to the Sui. Yang Su's fleet was able to continue down the Yangtze, joined with Liu Renen's troops, and turned again upon Qiting, breaking in the first month of 589 the position in which Lü Zhongsu had chained the river and taking the western mouth of the Xiling Gorge; in the same year Yang Su and Yang Jun joined forces at Hankou and the whole middle river passed to the Sui. After this the Chen had no strength left to organise any further defence of the upper river: Zhou Luohou, Chen Huiji and the rest were pinned at Hankou, Jingzhou and Xiangzhou fell in turn, and the main Sui armies were free to turn south on Jiankang. The numbers of men taken or killed in the fight at Langweitan are not stated in the histories, which preserve only the flight of Qi Xin and the night passage of the Sui through the racing current; but its place in the whole campaign against Chen is beyond question. It was the key that opened the upper Yangtze.
